issues.what: Carlist State keyframe carried the French Basque Country (Pyrenees-Atlantiques, 29 cells): the gazetteer's Basque Country region includes it, and the size rule gave the French land to the Carlists in 1873

al-Hasa fell to nobody's land for 1871-72 (about 1,300 cells in the snap): the Nejd ledger hands it to the Ottomans in 1871 but the Ottoman 1871 keyframe (Cliopatria) has it only from 1873 and snapped it away; now the Ottomans hold the Hasa part of Cliopatria's 1873 shape (317 cells) from 1871

523 cells of the Hexi corridor in Gansu (Jiuquan, Jiayuguan, Dunhuang) stayed nobody's land 1873-1876, a hole between Qing Gansu and Kumul, although Suzhou fell on 24 October 1873 and the corridor 'from Lanzhou to Dunhuang' was cleared; Cliopatria's 1873 Qing shape lacks them, the ledger's gain from dungan-revolt took nothing because the rebel holds none there

Dzungaria (about 1,330 cells) stayed nobody's land to the end of 1876 although Urumqi surrendered in August and Manas on 6 November 1876 (the ledger gain from dungan-revolt moves only that dossier's 22 cells; the 1877 snap then added 1,500+ cells at once); gain from nobody added, Turfan-Hami block left to 1877, clipped to Cliopatria's 1877 Qing shape

Bosnia and Herzegovina drawn as direct Austro-Hungarian land from 1878 (bosnia-eyalet ledger/19 'dissolve' hands it over at the end of the year; ottoman-empire ledger/192 'loss'), while the austria-hungary dossier and the pages say occupation under nominal Ottoman sovereignty until 1908; 10 further cells carried the roles reversed (Austria owner, Ottoman occupier). The dissolve runs after every other event of the year, so three patch events return the land to the Ottomans (eyalet loss, Austria's 10 cells) and draw the occupation

Presidente Hayes (323 cells) went from Bolivia to Paraguay in 1877 through the paraguay_1877 keyframe (324-cell snap, Bolivia -311), a year before the award; the ledger already has the 1878 gain. The keyframe now omits the department, so 1877 is nobody's land (the page names Argentina and Paraguay as the parties, not Bolivia) and Paraguay gains it in 1878
Ashanti lost Brong, Eastern, Adanse (231 cells) in the 1873 keyframe, a year before the Treaty of Fomena (13 Feb 1874) and the ledger losses of 1874; keyframe now cuts only the coast south of the Pra

Yettishar's Urumqi, Turfan and Manas area (about 1,500 cells of Dzungaria and Turfan) is nobody's land 1870-1875: the pages say Yaqub Beg defeated the Dungans at Urumqi in 1870, 'conquered almost all of Xinjiang' (Tacheng excepted) and held Urumqi and Turfan in 1876-77, but give no dated extent

Ili valley (Kuldja, about 106 cells) drawn as direct Russian land from 1871; Russia held it provisionally until 1881 (occupation), only 9 Qing cells are hatched. The Qing page gives no year for the occupation

dossier_requests.what: end year 1867 is too early as a state: Prussia stayed the largest state of the German Empire (a kingdom to November 1918); needs a life to 1918 and a constituent row under north-german-confederation / german-empire
dossier_requests.why: the Empire 'consisted of 25 states' that 'retained their own governments'; 'all German ruling kings, dukes, and princes abdicated' in November 1918

dossier_requests.what: dossier ends Jan 1871 and Bavaria is absorbed into a flat German Empire; the kingdom lasted to 1918 as a constituent of the empire (same for kingdom-of-saxony, kingdom-of-wurttemberg, grand-duchy-of-baden, grand-duchy-of-hesse, duchy-of-brunswick, duchy-of-mecklenburg, duchy-of-oldenburg, which also end in 1871)
dossier_requests.why: four constituent kingdoms, six grand duchies, five duchies, seven principalities, each keeping its government; hierarchy rows to german-empire exist only for alsace-lorraine, schaumburg-lippe and reuss-greiz

dossier_requests.what: ledger/19 is a 'dissolve' with counterpart austria-hungary, which hands the land over as direct Austro-Hungarian land at the end of 1878; it should be an occupation_start by Austria-Hungary (July 1878) with the dissolve passing the land to ottoman-empire (nominal sovereignty to 1908). The patch events/1-3 work around it and can be dropped when the dossier is fixed
dossier_requests.why: 'The Treaty of Berlin caused Bosnia and Herzegovina to nominally remain under sovereignty of the Ottoman Empire'; occupation 'started on 29 July 1878'

problems: hierarchy: row 'serbs,ottoman-empire,1830,1878,vassal,3' keeps Serbia in the Ottoman vassal tint to the end of 1878, although independence was recognised on 13 July 1878; the united-principalities row for Romania, same treaty, ends 1877; set the Serbian row's last year to 1877 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Congress_of_Berlin)

colonies.csv: 'west-prussia,german-empire,1871,1918' draws a Prussian province as a colony of the German Empire (106 cells from the 1878 keyframe, a 'colony' opening 1871); Prussia has no dossier after 1867, so there is no better metropole (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/German_Empire)
